_note: Every number the siting model uses. See ASSUMPTIONS.md. Change values here, not in code.

power._note: Indicative MW a new campus could draw from the existing >=230 kV network in the county, by highest line voltage. Rule of thumb: one 230 kV line carries ~200-400 MW, 345 kV ~400-900 MW, 500 kV 1,000+ MW.

water._note: On-site water per kWh of facility energy, by cooling design. Allowance = share of the county's public-supply withdrawals a single campus could take.

32510.where: Carson City, NV (commercial volume charge, Jul 2025)

land._note: Acres a campus needs per MW (buildings, substation, setbacks), and the share of a county's open land realistically available as large parcels.

facility._note_utilization: Average load as a share of the campus's maximum draw.
facility._note_min_viable_mw: Below this a county is flagged as too small for a large campus, whatever its score.

pricing._note: Cost model: yearly running cost plus a yearly charge on the land. Every number is shown in the app under Inputs and method. Guesses are flagged in ASSUMPTIONS.md (C1-C9).
pricing._note_ppa: A PPA price covers energy only; the campus still pays the utility to deliver it.
pricing._note_capacity: Capacity-market price for new large loads, $/MW-day of campus MW, added on top of the state rate (part of it may already be in that rate, so this errs high). Grids with no capacity market are assumed to carry it inside the state rate. MISO counties in the South states use the South zone price.

capacity_where.ISNE: ISO-NE FCA 18 for 2027/28, all zones, preliminary ($3.58/kW-month)
capacity_where.NYIS: NYISO summer 2026 spot, Long Island and rest of state (about $10/kW-month)

pricing._note_water: The default water rate is scaled by water stress (0 -> low, 100 -> high). Verified local rates are used as they are.
pricing._note_land: Land is bought once: campus acres x state farmland value x a premium for being near a big line. A yearly charge (capital_charge) turns it into a yearly cost.
